title: V7 development result
purpose: Present the model result with the correct uncertainty.
takeaway: The semantic-plus-context prototype reached 0.6644 validation ROC-AUC and did not validate a replacement for V5.

bullets: The paired validation difference was -0.0099, with a 95% website-bootstrap interval from -0.0337 to +0.0135.

speaker_notes: Define ROC-AUC as ranking top above bottom records within this sampled problem.
